messages:
anya-sec: Noticing increased mTLS failures in ap-northeast-1 after the RBAC policy sweep.

maria-infra: which errors?

anya-sec: proxy logs: `keystore unwrap: kms.DecryptAccessDenied for role arn:aws:iam::111:role/proxy-keystore-apac`

lee-oncall: rolling back the deny for that role now. also enabling local keystore cache as a short-term mitigation.

audit-bot: Incident created: INC-20260330-APAC-KMS (P1)

maria-infra: found policy diff that added a broad deny statement; missed explicit allow for proxy-keystore. will patch.

anya-sec: recommend CI test that does an sts:AssumeRole + kms:Decrypt dry-run. open infra ticket?

maria-infra: filed infra-2501 (policy preflight dry-run), infra-2502 (add KMS Decrypt alerting to SIEM).

lee-oncall: cache flip reduced errors from ~15% to ~2%. patch applied, monitoring healthy.

anya-sec: good. postmortem and tighter RBAC checklist plz.
